stemMd: What is the minimum value of f(x) = x² + 2x + 5 over real x?
explanationMd: Complete the square: f(x)=(x+1)²+4. The square is at least zero and reaches zero at x=−1, so the minimum output is four. Distinguish the minimizing input from the minimum value.

distractorRationale.b: This is the value at zero, not the minimum.
distractorRationale.a: This is the input where the minimum occurs.
distractorRationale.e: The completed square has an additional positive constant.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses the sign of the minimum.
